prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ETS', seasonality_champion='FT_catboost', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: FT_catboost dominates overall (RMSE=177.7) and leads in seasonality capture (corr=0.573), while ETS achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0). The extreme RMSE spread (14.4) and high seasonality variance (0.798) indicate significant model disagreement, making STL-hierarchical stacking ideal to decompose and recombine trend/seasonal components separately. Early horizon specialist ONLY_CWT_catboost (105.1 RMSE) differs from late specialist FT_catboost (160.6 RMSE), suggesting per-horizon optimization could further improve performance.
